description: Applies one requested change to an existing component's HTML (for example the output of generate_component) with the AnimatedWebs AI generator and returns the complete updated HTML document as plain text, preceded by an HTML comment naming the model and the generations left today. Use this to iterate on a result; use generate_component to start a new component from scratch. Uses one daily generation like generate_component (Free 5, Pro 100 per UTC day, shared); a call where no model ran is not counted. Requires sign-in, is not idempotent, and may answer that the generator is busy, in which case retry after a minute.

change.description: One change to make, 4 to 800 characters. Example: 'make the cards glass and add a hover tilt'.

html.description: The current component as a full HTML document, 50 to 60,000 characters; pass the previous output unchanged.

style.description: Visual system to keep: luxury, editorial, glass or brutalist. Pass the style used when the component was generated; default luxury.

name: refine_component
title: Refine UI component
